background: Minnesota-raised career assistant who started as Brooklyn's video coordinator (2011-13), became a Nets assistant under Jason Kidd in 2013, and followed Kidd to Milwaukee (2014-18). Ran the defense for Dwane Casey in Detroit (2018-21), then was Kidd's defensive coordinator in Dallas (2021-25), where the Mavericks reached the 2022 West finals and 2024 NBA Finals with a switch-heavy, zone-mixing, rim-protected scheme. Joined San Antonio as associate head coach in June 2025 and is credited as the architect of a defense that jumped from 25th to 3rd in rating around DPOY Victor Wembanyama as the Spurs reached the 2026 Finals (lost to New York). Hired by Orlando on June 1, 2026 (introduced June 18) over finalists Jeff Van Gundy and Billy Donovan; first head-coaching job. Self-described identity: 'aggressive with balance', communication, 'trust is earned', daily habits; expected to keep Orlando's defensive foundation while modernizing a historically stagnant offense.

Spurs' 2026 Finals defensive breakdowns vs Brunson/Knicks were pinned partly on the scheme (LWOS, June 2026).
Inherits an injury-prone star duo (Banchero/Wagner missed 58 games combined in 2025-26).
key_strengths: Elite defensive schemer: Spurs 25th to 3rd in one season (2025-26); Dallas 2024 Finals defense; Detroit under Casey.
Flexible, matchup-based coverages including heavy zone and drop/switch toggling.
Communication and culture emphasis ('trust is earned'); well regarded by peers, beat two experienced finalists for the job.
Inherits a ready-made defensive roster (Suggs, Wagner, Isaac, Carter) suited to his principles.
